# Eleven src/ai unit specs live only in the Brain, executed by nothing

## Context

Grace's coverage question on neo-agent-brain PR #484 (the Brain's engine pin moved a month, `17b59aad` → `7f16355a`) asked for the full Brain unit suite at that head diffed against dev's known-red baseline. The receipt is on neo-agent-brain#482. Its only pin-attributable delta is nine red arms in two Brain specs whose subject is this repository's `src/ai/Client.mjs`:

- `test/playwright/unit/ai/ClientAgentDisconnect.spec.mjs` (6 arms)
- `test/playwright/unit/ai/ClientWindowRegistration.spec.mjs` (3 arms)

Both set `client.isConnected = false` in `beforeEach`. `4802862b73` (#18956, PR #18970) made `isConnected` a getter that reads `this.socket?.socket?.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN` (`src/ai/Client.mjs:110`), so the assignment throws `TypeError: Cannot set property isConnected of #<Client> which has only a getter`. Same tree minus the bump (`77bfa56`, engine `17b59aad`): all nine arms pass. Head (`c749efc`, engine `7f16355a`): all nine fail. Nothing else in the two runs' failing sets differs by more than the arms PR #484 added.

No engine runtime path changed for the Brain: no Brain runtime module assigns `isConnected` or imports the client (checked at neo-agent-brain `origin/dev`), so the plane recut that ships the new pin is unaffected. The break is confined to tests, and it stayed invisible for 20 days because the tests live in a repository whose CI never executes them.

## The Problem

`c623b2f63c` (#17806) moved the unit specs of the Engine-side `src/ai/**` surface into the Brain together with the Brain implementation. #17968 (PR #18002) restored twelve of them; eleven more remain, all `brain-only` (no engine spec of the same name), all importing the engine as a package:

| Brain spec (`test/playwright/unit/ai/`) | engine subject |
|---|---|
| `ClientAgentDisconnect.spec.mjs` | `src/ai/Client.mjs` |
| `ClientDispatcher.spec.mjs` | `src/ai/Client.mjs` |
| `ClientWindowRegistration.spec.mjs` | `src/ai/Client.mjs` |
| `InstanceServiceCreateInstance.spec.mjs` | `src/ai/client/InstanceService.mjs`, `TransactionService.mjs`, `WriteGuard.mjs` |
| `InstanceServiceCreateUndoCapture.spec.mjs` | same |
| `InstanceServiceListTransactions.spec.mjs` | `src/ai/client/InstanceService.mjs`, `TransactionService.mjs` |
| `InstanceServiceNamedTransaction.spec.mjs` | same |
| `InstanceServiceRedo.spec.mjs` | `src/ai/client/InstanceService.mjs`, `TransactionService.mjs`, `WriteGuard.mjs` |
| `InstanceServiceRemoveUndoCapture.spec.mjs` | same |
| `InstanceServiceUndo.spec.mjs` | same |
| `InstanceServiceUndoCapture.spec.mjs` | same |

Census: `git grep -l 'neo\.mjs/src/ai/' origin/dev -- test/playwright/unit` in neo-agent-brain (11 files, 2026-09-25), basenames compared against `git ls-tree -r --name-only 7f16355a test/playwright/unit` here (0 shared).

Three consequences, in the order they bit:

1. **The engine cannot fail on its own contract change.** #18970 changed how `isConnected` is read; the engine's `unit` check had nothing to run against it, and the PR merged green.
2. **The Brain cannot fail either.** `brain-unit.yml` executes a named run list (neo-agent-brain#201, the collected-not-executed class); none of the eleven is on it. The reds surfaced only through a manual full-suite run 20 days later.
3. **The Brain's next pin bump inherits the break** and has to reason about a test failure whose fix is not in its repository.

This is the general sweep #17968 scoped out (*"a general 'does this deleted spec's subject still exist in the Engine?' sweep is worth doing and is not this"*), bounded to the population that still imports `src/ai/**`.

## The Architectural Reality

- `src/ai/Client.mjs:110` — `get isConnected()` reads the socket; its docblock states why a flag was wrong (a failing socket reports `error` before `close`, and a stale flag routes the failure's own log through the failed socket).
- The engine's unit tree already holds this subject family: `test/playwright/unit/ai/{LockRegistry,TransactionService,WriteGuard,admitWrite,deriveSubtreePath,parseAgentEnvelope,resolveWriteLock}.spec.mjs` and `test/playwright/unit/ai/client/{ComponentService,DockService,InstanceService,InteractionService,RuntimeService,TourRunner,…}.spec.mjs`, restored by PR #18002 with relative `src/` imports (`test/playwright/unit/ai/TransactionService.spec.mjs:2-5`). That is the placement precedent; no new directory.
- `npm run test-unit` (`playwright.config.unit.mjs`, project `unit-engine`, `testDir: unit`) executes everything under `test/playwright/unit/`; `test.yml`'s `unit` suite runs exactly that whenever the change classifier's `run_unit` fires, so an adopted spec executes on every engine PR that touches its subject.
- The Brain specs run under its `unit-brain` project and import the engine as a package (`await import('neo.mjs/src/ai/Client.mjs')`, `ClientAgentDisconnect.spec.mjs:64`) with a Brain-local `setup` helper; adoption replaces both with the engine's relative-import shape.

## The Fix

One engine PR:

1. Adopt the eleven specs under `test/playwright/unit/ai/` (`Client*`) and `test/playwright/unit/ai/client/` (`InstanceService*`), with relative `src/` imports and the engine's own unit setup, following PR #18002's shape. Arms that duplicate an already-restored engine spec are dropped, not copied.
2. In the two `isConnected` specs, drive the getter's real input instead of assigning it: give the client a socket double whose `socket.readyState` is `WebSocket.OPEN` / `CLOSED` per arm. The assertion set stays; only the fixture moves to the contract #18970 defined.
3. The Brain deletes its eleven copies once this merges (neo-agent-brain#486), so neither repository holds a second authority.

**Decision Record impact:** none. Custody precedent: #17968 / PR #18002.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Every arm of the eleven Brain specs exists in this repository's unit tree, or is named in the PR body as a duplicate of an arm PR #18002 already restored, with the engine spec it duplicates.
- [ ] The adopted `ClientAgentDisconnect` and `ClientWindowRegistration` arms pass against `get isConnected()` by controlling the socket double's `readyState`; no arm assigns `isConnected`.
- [ ] `npm run test-unit` at the PR head executes the adopted specs (the run's `[n/N]` lines name them) and is green.
- [ ] neo-agent-brain#486 (the Brain-side deletion) is open and linked; after both merge, the census command above returns nothing.

## Out of Scope

- The Brain's other retained-suite classes (missing inputs, order pollution, obsolete surfaces): neo-agent-brain#201 / #191 own their dispositions.
- Changing `isConnected` back to a flag, or any `src/ai` runtime change.
- The engine's `checkEngineBrainBoundary.spec.mjs`, which references `src/ai/Client.mjs` as a boundary fixture, not as a subject.

## Related

- #17968 / PR #18002 — the first twelve restored; the custody decision this continues.
- #18956 / PR #18970 (`4802862b73`) — the contract change that broke the two specs.
- neo-agent-brain#482 / PR #484 — the pin bump and the full-suite receipt.
- neo-agent-brain#201 — the Brain's run list; the reason the reds were invisible.
- neo-agent-brain#486 — the Brain-side deletion plus the `prepare.spec.mjs` run-list line.
